name: Sony Koshi image sensor fab (Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing)

parties.name: Sony Semiconductor Solutions
parties.note: Built the Koshi fab and plans to be the sole controlling shareholder of the venture, which is to be consolidated by Sony Group.

parties.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC)
parties.note: Minority partner contributing cash and its process technology and manufacturing expertise.

summary: A fab that Sony has newly built in Koshi, Kumamoto Prefecture, which Sony and TSMC plan to turn into a joint venture for development and volume production of smartphone image sensors with advanced process technology. A non-binding memorandum was signed in May 2026 and a binding agreement in August 2026 to set up Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation, with Sony in control. Sony plans to contribute about ¥465 billion, partly by transferring the fab, and TSMC about ¥282 billion in cash, in phases tied to demand; the venture expects volume production in 2029, subject to approvals and Japanese government support for further investment.

metrics.note: Sony's planned contribution in cash and assets, including the Koshi fab, to be made in phases.
TSMC's planned cash contribution, to be made in phases.

milestones.note: Completion date not stated; Sony described the Koshi fab as newly constructed when the venture was first announced in May 2026, with development and production lines still to be set up.
Non-binding memorandum of understanding for the joint venture.
Expected start of volume production by the joint venture.

notes: The joint venture's establishment depends on regulatory approvals and closing conditions. Sony said in May 2026 that it was also considering new investment at its existing Nagasaki plant; that is not part of this record.
